examples.english: I look at the people in the street
examples.transliteration: anthur ila al nas fi al shari

examples.arabic: ابتسم الشرطي واشار بيده الى الشارع القريب ليصله بامان
examples.english: The policeman smiled and pointed with his hand to the nearby street to reach it safely.
examples.transliteration: ibtasama ash shurti wa ashara biyadihi ila ash shari al qarib liyasulahu bi aman

examples.arabic: لذا اندفع نحو فرع بنك مصر الواقع في شارع الجامعة محاولا ترتيب أفكاره المشتتة بينما يتصبب عرقا.
examples.english: Therefore, he rushed toward the Bank Misr branch located on University Street, trying to organize his scattered thoughts while dripping with sweat.
examples.transliteration: lidha indafa'a nahwa far'i banki misr al-waqi'i fi shari'i al-jami'ati muhawilan tartiba afkarihi al-mushattatati baynama yatasabbabu araqan.
examples.storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

examples.arabic: طلبت قهوة عربية و نظرت الى الشارع
examples.english: I ordered Arabic coffee and looked at the street.
examples.transliteration: Talabto qahwatan Arabiyyah wa nazarto ila ash-shari'

examples.english: I see many cars on the street.
I am in a big street now.
